You will turn ambition into a plan, a decision framework and a delivery rhythm that HR, our internal Workday technology team and external partners can all follow. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, and will work closely with People Operations, People Partners, Centres of Expertise and Tech teams. jobs.title: Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - EMEA
jobs.company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
jobs.description: Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further. We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working in EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. You’ll own it across our target markets (UK&I, France, Nordics and Benelux), from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos. This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention. A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in London regularly, plus one trip to another EMEA city a month, usually for around four days. Busier periods can mean two trips abroad in a month. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice. It’s also one of the best parts of the job. jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: People Operations Coordinator About Runa: Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. Businesses worldwide send over $20 trillion annually in rewards, remittances, and disbursements often incurring costs of up to 50% per transaction and subjecting recipients to lengthy delays. Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. The Runa API empowers thousands of businesses to make payments to 5 billion+ consumers in 190+ countries instantly to cards, wallets, bank accounts and gift cards. Leading companies such as Sodexo, TopCashback, Perkbox, Sweatcoin, Coinbase, and Globetopper rely on Runa to facilitate instant, flexible global payouts to tens of millions of consumers. About the Role: We’re looking for a People Operations Coordinator to join the Runa, People & Talent team and play a key role in delivering an exceptional employee experience. In this position, you’ll own vital HR processes, including onboarding and offboarding, HiBob and employee data, payroll and benefits changes and compliance, ensuring our people feel supported and engaged. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with some HR experience who is ready to take on more ownership in a dynamic, fast-paced setting. Working directly with our People & Talent Lead, you’ll be exposed to the full employee lifecycle, build your skills across HR operations and compliance and help shape how our People processes scale as Runa grows. What Excites You Being the reliable go-to person for employees across the business and helping them have a positive workplace experience. jobs.description: Über pplwise pplwise ist eine Recruiting-Beratung für schnell wachsende Technologieunternehmen in ganz Europa. Mit Recruiting as a Service und Executive Search besetzen wir Schlüsselpositionen für unsere Kunden – vom Start-up bis zum börsennotierten Unternehmen. Diese Position besetzen wir für unseren Kunden Filics. Über unseren Kunden: Filics Filics erfindet die Intralogistik neu – mit autonomen mobilen Robotern (AMR), die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Dank seines Double-Runner-Systems ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten hindurchfahren kann. Das bricht mit der Gabelstapler-Logik und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Filics ist ein kleines, praxisorientiertes Team, das schwierige Probleme mit technischer Exzellenz löst. Führung übernimmt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Senior Entwicklungsingenieur -Mechanik bei Filics leitest du die mechanische Konstruktion der Roboter auf dem Weg vom Prototyp zur Serienfertigung. Die Rolle Die Stelle ist vor Ort/hybrid in München, nah an Entwicklung und Montage. Filics entwickelt seine Roboter-Hardware komplett selbst: Mechanik, Elektronik und Software. Die Auftragslage wächst, und die Roboter gehen vom Prototyp in die Serie. Konstruktionen, die im Labor funktioniert haben, müssen jetzt zuverlässig, in Stückzahl und zu den richtigen Kosten gebaut werden. Die schwierigsten Probleme liegen oft zwischen den Disziplinen: Teile, die für sich allein funktionieren, können versagen, sobald sie mit der Elektronik verbaut sind. jobs.title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. jobs.title: Founding Talent Lead
jobs.description: Role We are hiring someone to build up and own our talent function end-to-end. Recruiting, developing and retaining the best people is absolutely fundamental to our success. It’s also one of the most fun parts of building. Together with our founders, you will build and own the entire talent stack: we’ll start with sourcing and winning the best talent (including building a long-term talent pool that we can rely on as we scale), and then move into building performance reviews and people development. We have come this far because we have the best people, and we will go further because we keep finding them. Your job is to make sure that the biggest constraint on our growth is never people. What you will do We are scaling incredibly fast across all functions. We are 25 people today and will be a multiple of that next year. Winning talent: you find the best people for engineering, sales, and ops roles, build the channels that keep candidates coming, and help the team turn the right ones into hires. You’ll help us do whatever it takes to recruit the best talent (even if that is a creative signing present). You make sure our recruiting process is ultra fast and convincing. You define the steps, keep candidates moving fast, prepare the team for interviews, and make sure we do not lose people we wanted. When someone turns us down, you build the strategy to change their minds. Beyond immediate hiring needs, you’ll build a long-term talent network (feel free to host amazing events). People development: we don’t really have a structured process for this today. We may never. You’ll work with us on defining the right approach for performance management and people development at BEO, so we not only win the best talent but also retain and develop it. Tool stack, automation, and tool building: you own every tool in the talent stack, from ATS and outreach to scheduling, feedback, and onboarding. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future.
